stepBody:
Suppose after training our model we get
$$ eta=(-1.2, -0.005, 2.5)$$
where $$-1.2$$ is an intercept term, $$-0.005$$ is the parameter corresponding to passenger's age, and $$2.5$$ is the parameter corresponding to sex.
Consider a $$20$$ year old female passenger. What chance did she have to survive the sinking of the Titanic according to our model? Give your answer as a probability in terms of $$\sigma.$$ If there is not enough information, choose not enough information.
